gloss: to evoke; to call up; to arouse

definitions.gloss: to evoke; to call up; to arouse (memories, feelings, interest)
definitions.explanation: To bring a memory, feeling, or reaction to life in someone's mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{起|お}こす。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{起|お}こした。
examples.english: The smell brought back childhood memories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{起|お}こし、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧になった。
examples.english: His speech aroused people's interest and set off a major debate.

notes:
Literally 'call and wake'. It can still mean to wake someone by calling, but it usually takes an abstract object.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{起|お}こす: to call up memories
- ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{起|お}こす: to arouse interest
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{起|お}こす: to stir emotions
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{起|お}こす: to provoke debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}させる→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: to remind (everyday)
- ⟦{喚起|かんき}→喚起：28817_kanki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to arouse, to raise (awareness; formal)
